scale_cues: Square white dinner plate about 26-27 cm across fills most of the frame and is the main reference. Broccoli florets look about 4-6 cm across. Pork slices look about 4-5 cm across and 1.5-2 cm thick. No cutlery or hand is visible.
assumptions: The meat is lean pork tenderloin, not chicken thigh. If it is chicken thigh, calories are about the same and protein is a bit lower.
The small golden strip at the bottom is a breaded chicken tender or breaded fish piece.
The salad greens look glossy, so they are dressed with a light oil-based vinaigrette.
The broccoli looks steamed with little or no added fat. A small amount of cooking oil is counted separately for the pork.
The carrot, red onion and dried cranberries each weigh under 5 g, so they are grouped as one item.
